name: Goats
overview: Scripture presents goats as valuable livestock, providing resources such as milk and serving as a price for land, as seen in Proverbs 27:26-27. God’s sovereign judgment distinguishes between goats and sheep, symbolizing separation and accountability, notably illustrated in Ezekiel 34:17 and Matthew 25:32. This distinction points to Christ’s role as the righteous judge who will separate the nations, highlighting the spiritual significance of goats beyond their practical use.
